npc.captain_dreadnought.say_1: So you want to donate {} gold coins? The little kiddies are going to appreciate it.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_10: Cast off! Don't forget to talk to the guide at the port for directions to nearest bars... err, shops and bank and such!
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_11: Changed your mind? Which city do you want to head to, {}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_12: Changed your mind? Which city do you want to head to, {}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_13: Kid, listen. Answering with a clear {yes} or {no} will get you much further in Tibia. Most people are not as sharp-eared as I am. Got that?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_14: Errr... was that a foreign language? Could you just answer with a clear {yes} or {no}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_15: Aw, come on! Talk to me in human words! {Yes}, {no}, or mention a city's name, that kind of stuff.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_2: Well, that's really generous of you. That'll feed a lot of hungry mouths for a while. Right, now which {city} did you say you wanted to go to?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_3: Well, har har. Very funny. Come on, pick up the gold you just dropped.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_4: By tempest! What's all this gold weighing us down? Don't you think that's a little risky with all these pirates around? You can take {} with you, but that's it. Drop the rest or {donate} it to the Adventurers' Orphans Fund, really.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_5: What? Whatever that is, it's not a port I sail to. {}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_6: What? Whatever that is, it's not a port I sail to. {}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_7: Negative, can't bring you there without a premium account. You should be glad you get to travel by ship - usually that's a premium service too, you know.
npc.captain_dreadnought.say_9: By tempest! What's all this gold weighing us down? Don't you think that's a little risky with all these pirates around? You can take {} with you, but that's it. Drop the rest or {donate} it to the Adventurers' Orphans Fund, really.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_1: Ruby Dreadnought. But it's Captain Dreadnought to you!
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_10: While you take time to ponder, I will just stroll over there and pretend not to listen to you thinking.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_11: Well, I can tell you stuff about {}.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_12: Do you want to know about {}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_13: So, you've decided on your new home city? Which one will it be?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_2: I'm captain of this little sloop here, the Sea Cat.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_3: She's pretty, isn't she? Will ship you safely to any port. Though a young landlubber such as you should consider to travel to Thais first. The travel is for free. Just once though! You have to ask for a {passage}.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_4: You chose a peaceful world. Not much danger from other adventurers. Just beware the monsters. Want go there, ask for a {passage}.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_5: That old place? Sorry, I don't sail there, no loot to be had.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_6: Some regions in the world can't be accessed by everyone. Gotta pay, you know? If you spend some real cash for premium time, I can bring you to much more challenging locations.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_7: That's what the whole place is called.
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_8: Good. Got all you want to take to the mainland, {yes}? Gear, limbs, loot?
npc.captain_dreadnought.stdmod_9: What? Then what DO you want? Learn about the main Tibian {cities}?
npc.captain_dreadnought.voice_1: No smuggling aboard this ship! Only 20 pieces of any creature product allowed!
npc.captain_dreadnought.voice_2: No fear! The Sea Cat will ship you safely to the mainland!
npc.captain_dreadnought.voice_4: Come hell or high water, we'll reach any port I sail you to!
npc.captain_dreadnought.voice_5: This island is too small. I need sea water around me.

npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_4: Ah, you may not have heard of me. I am Captain Gulliver, the first Oramondian for a hundred years to have sailed through the mist to your strange lands.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_5: I am the captain of the 'Sea Goddess', the splendid and beautiful ship you see over there.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_6: I am the captain of the 'Sea Goddess', the splendid and beautiful ship you see over there.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_7: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_8: Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.
npc.captain_gulliver.stdmod_9: I will gladly take on board everything you wish to transport. No pets, though.
npc.captain_gulliver.voice_1: Passages to Thais and Krailos! Visit the strange lands!
npc.captain_haba.greet_msg_1: Harrr, landlubber wha'd ya want? Askin' for a {passage}?
npc.captain_haba.say_1: Hold your horses! First we need to get more {bait} fo' the sea serpent. Bring me the fish I requested and we can set sails immediately.
npc.captain_haba.say_10: Excellent, that should be enough fish to make the bait. Tell me when ya're ready fo' the {hunt}.
npc.captain_haba.say_11: The bait is ready, tell me if ya're ready to start the hunt.
npc.captain_haba.say_2: Ya wanna join the hunt fo' the {sea serpent}? Be warned ya may pay with ya life! Are ya in to it?
npc.captain_haba.say_4: A'right, wanna put out to sea?
npc.captain_haba.say_5: A'right, we are here to resupply our stock of baits to catch the sea serpent. Your first task is to bring me 5 fish they are easy to catch. When you got them ask me for the {bait} again.
npc.captain_haba.say_6: Let's go fo' a {hunt} and bring the beast down!
npc.captain_haba.say_7: Excellent, now bring me 5 northern pike.
npc.captain_haba.say_8: Excellent, now bring me 5 green perch.
npc.captain_haba.say_9: Excellent, now bring me 5 rainbow trout.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_1: Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_10: Dis is no passenger ship it's a WARship. I'm on hunting business.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_11: Never heard of him. He is no captain that's for sure, otherwise I'd know him. I was on the sea for the last 20 years hunting this, this monster.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_12: Yee, I've been chasing that monster for over 20 years now. I promise I'll bring it down!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_13: It lets me forget the long years, the lost years. The years I was chasing after THAT monster, the sea serpent.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_15: Our last ship has been destroyed by the most evil creature of the ocean: the sea serpent. To continue our hunt, I've bought this ship here.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_17: I'm faithful - I'll catch that monster one day. Yes I will, as sure as my name is Captain Haba!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_18: On the high seas there is no queen. At least I didn't see her yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_19: On the high seas there is no king. At least I didn't see him yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_2: In the rigging ya lazy fools!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_20: Arms, legs, head, whatever. I got injuries on almost every part of my body!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_21: This is no shop boy, this is a warship!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_22: We aren't even near that location! Wanna swim? Harharhar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_23: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_24: My worst enemy is a huge sea serpent. I dunno when I started to follow it's trail. I'll kill it and if it's the last thing I'll do, I'll kill it!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_3: I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_4: Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_5: My name is Haba, Captain Haba for ya little worm.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_6: I ain't no pirate. Don't let yourself mislead by my pirate hat. I got it from a friend of mine.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_7: Most o' my friends are dead the others don't like me anymore......well, seems there aren't many left.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_8: What fo' godsake shall that be??
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_9: Who are ya calling a barbarian?!? Watch your tongue here on board or you end up as fish fodder!
npc.captain_haba.voice_1: Is this a mutiny or what? Move, move!!
npc.captain_haba.voice_2: In the rigging ya lazy fools!
npc.captain_haba.voice_3: I wanna see you movin' ya lazy fools!!
npc.captain_haba.voice_4: Full sails!! There's a sea serpent to catch!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.greet_msg_1: Wha'd ya want? Ask me 'bout the {instructions} if you don't know what to do! If you wanna head back to {Svargrond}, let me know.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.greet_msg_2: You found the spot |PLAYERNAME|!! Grab yourself a helmet of the deep and go explore the {caves} down there.
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_1: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_3: SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! TO THE LARBOARD SIDE, FAST!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_4: LARBOARD!! THY DOES THIS TAKE SO LONG?!? LET'S GET IT ON!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.larboard_5: LET'S GO YOU LAZY FOOLS. WE GOT A SEA SERPENT TO CATCH! TO LARBOARD SIDE, GO, GO, GO!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.multi_1: Ya gotta learn a lot! The correct command would be STARBOARD side. ...
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.multi_2: After you told me about the direction, put a bait on the crane again and go up to the lookout! That would be all sailor, let's go hunt down the sea serpent!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.multi_3: A'right, first of all you need a bait which isn't for free, though. I sell them for 50 gold each. Use the bait on the crane over there when you see something in the telescope. ...
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.multi_4: Then go up to the lookout and check the telescope for a sight of the sea serpent. ...
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.multi_5: If you see it in front of ya, get down at once. And what d'ya gonna say to me?
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.say_1: Harharhar, landlubber, no no!! The correct command would be STRAIGHT. Remember that! Next, what you gonna say when you see something to left?
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.say_2: Harharhar, landlubber, ya got it all wrong!! The correct command would be LARBOARD side. Don't forget that, 'kay? Last one, what you gonna say to me when ya see somethin' to the right?
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.say_3: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.say_4: Already got enough, huh? I kind o' expected that, landlubber! Let's head for Svargrond! Ready?
npc.captain_haba_open_sea.say_5: Y' already wanna give up?? I should've known. I bring ya back to Svargrond, 'kay?

npc.caramellia.greet_msg_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Please leave me alone in my {mourning}.
npc.caramellia.multi_1: Once, this tower has been my prison but after the death of Winfred it has become my refuge from the rest of the world. ...
npc.caramellia.multi_2: I welcome the loneliness here because it mirrors the state of my heart.
npc.caramellia.multi_3: He wasn't a bad man. He was only misguided by false friends who told him what society expected of him ...
npc.caramellia.multi_4: By trying to uphold a respectable image in society, he ruined not only my life but also his own.
npc.caramellia.multi_5: [EN] We met anyway, we had plans to flee to {Port Hope} and to start a new life there ...
npc.caramellia.multi_6: [EN] A {druid}, in service of my father, had spied on us. So they brought me here and locked me into this {tower}. The druid cast a spell on the plants at the entrance which kept everyone from entering the tower ...
npc.caramellia.multi_7: [EN] I could see Winfred from the window but he could not come to me. One day he disappeared. I knew immediately that something horrible had happened to him.
npc.caramellia.multi_8: I could see Winfred from the window but he could not come to me. One day he disappeared. I knew immediately that something horrible had happened to him.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_1: Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.stdmod_10: My father wanted me to marry a wealthy Venorean. He understood so little about love and the ways of the heart.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_2: Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_3: All is lost. With {Winfred} dead, my love has died and I'm only an empty shell without hope or purpose.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_4: We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never know what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_5: I guess he was the one that put my father up to the whole thing. He spied on Winfred and me and it was certainly him that suggested my {imprisonment} in this tower.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_6: This forsaken place seems as remote from the rest of the world as my heart is.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_7: Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_8: The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_9: Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.
npc.caramellia.voice_1: Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.voice_2: Please leave me alone in my mourning.

npc.carlos.greet_msg_8: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Where did you put that delicious piece of food? Did you eat it yourself? Well, if you find another one, please come back.
npc.carlos.greet_msg_9: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!

npc.carlos.say_1: Very well. Just choose an outfit and a colour combination that suits you. You can open this dialogue anytime by right-clicking on yourself and selecting 'Set Outfit'. Just try it and then talk to me again!
npc.carlos.say_2: You see, I'm quite hungry from standing here all day. Could you get me some {food}?
npc.carlos.say_3: Thank you! I would do it myself, but I don't have a weapon. Just kill a few rabbits or deer, loot food from them and bring me one piece of {meat} or ham, will you?
npc.carlos.say_4: Splendid. I'll be awaiting your return eagerly. Don't forget that you can click on the 'Chase Opponent' button to run after those fast creatures. Good {bye} for now!
npc.carlos.say_5: What's that delicious smell? That must be a piece of meat! Please hurry, simply ask me for a {trade} and I'll give you two gold pieces for it!

npc.carlos.sendtrade_msg_1: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.

npc.cedrik.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.cedrik.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.cedrik.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.cedrik.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.ceiron.farewell_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ceiron.greet_msg_1: Always nice to meet a fellow druid, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ceiron.multi_1: I hope that I am not asking too much of you with this task. I heard of a flower which is currently unique in Tibia and can survive at only one place. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_10: Have you understood everything I told you and will fulfil this task for me?
npc.ceiron.multi_11: I'm glad that you are still with me, |PLAYERNAME|. Especially because my next task might require even more patience from your side than the ones before. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_12: Demons... these unholy creatures should have never been able to walk the earth. They are a brood fueled only by hatred and malice. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_13: Even if slain, their evil spirit is not fully killed. It needs a blessed stake to release their last bit of fiendishness and turn them into dust. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_14: It does not work all the time, but if you succeed, their vicious spirit is finally defeated. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_15: I want proof that you are on the right side, against Zathroth. Bring me 100 ounces of demon dust and I shall be convinced. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_16: You will probably need to ask a priest for help to obtain a blessed stake. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_17: Have you understood everything I told you and will fulfil this task for me?
npc.ceiron.multi_18: Listen, my next task for you is not exactly easy either. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_19: In the mountains between Ankrahmun and Tiquanda are two hydra lairs. The nothern one has many waterfalls whereas the southern one has just tiny water trickles. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_2: This place is somewhere in the bleak mountains of Nargor. I would love to have a sample of its blossom, but the problem is that it seldom actually blooms. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_20: However, these trickles are said to contain water as pure and clean as nowhere else in Tibia. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_21: If you could reach one of these trickles and retrieve a water sample for me, it would be a great help. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_22: It is important that you take the water directly from the trickle, not from the pond - else it will not be as pure anymore. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_23: Have you understood everything I told you and will fulfil this task for me?
npc.ceiron.multi_3: I cannot afford to travel there each day just to check whether the time has already come, besides I have no idea where to start looking. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_4: I would be deeply grateful if you could support me in this matter and collect a sample of the blooming Griffinclaw for me. ...
npc.ceiron.multi_5: Have you understood everything I told you and will fullfil this task for me?
npc.ceiron.multi_6: I have one final task for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Many months ago, I was trying to free the war wolves which are imprisoned inside the orc fortress.
npc.ceiron.multi_7: Unfortunately, my intrusion was discovered and I had to run for my life. During my escape, I lost my favourite wolf tooth chain.
npc.ceiron.multi_8: It should still be somewhere in the fortress, if the orcs did not try to eat it. I really wish you could retrieve it for me.
npc.ceiron.multi_9: It has the letter 'C' carved into one of the teeth. Please look for it.
npc.ceiron.say_1: What are you thinking! I would never allow you to slay my beloved friends for the sake of your narcism. Only {Faolan} can grant you a fur like this one.
npc.ceiron.say_10: Crunor be praised! The Griffinclaw really exists! Now, I will make sure that it will not become extinct. If you are ready to help me again, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.ceiron.say_11: Great! Here, take my waterskin and try to fill it with water from this special trickle. Don't lose my waterskin, I will not accept some random dirty waterskin.
npc.ceiron.say_12: Good work, |PLAYERNAME|! This water looks indeed extremely clear. I will examine it right away. If you are ready to help me again, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.ceiron.say_13: I'm very impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. With this task you have proven that you are on the right side and are powerful as well. If you are ready to help me again, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.ceiron.say_14: I'm very impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. With this task you have proven that you are on the right side and are powerful as well. If you are ready to help me again, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.ceiron.say_15: Thank you so much. I can't wait to wear it around my neck again, it was a special present from Faolan.
npc.ceiron.say_16: Crunor be praised! You found my beloved chain! |PLAYERNAME|, you really earned my respect and I consider you as a friend from now on. Remind me to tell you about {Faolan} sometime.
npc.ceiron.say_17: I can give you a new one, but I fear that I have to take a small fee for it. Would you like to buy a waterskin for 1000 gold?
npc.ceiron.say_2: I know where the great wolf mother lives, but I will not tell that to just anyone. You have to earn my respect first. Are you willing to help me?
npc.ceiron.say_3: Right, I will keep my promise. Faolan roams Tibia freely, but her favourite sleeping cave is on Cormaya. I will now enchant you so you will be able to speak the wolf language.
npc.ceiron.say_4: Were you able to obtain a sample of the Griffinclaw?
npc.ceiron.say_5: Did you bring me a sample of water from the hydra cave?
npc.ceiron.say_6: Were you really able to collect 100 ounces of demon dust?
npc.ceiron.say_7: Have you really found my wolf tooth chain??
npc.ceiron.say_9: Alright then. Take this botanist's container and return to me once you were able to retrieve a sample. Don't lose patience!
npc.ceiron.walkaway_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.cerdras.farewell_msg_1: May Crunor bless and guide you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.cerdras.multi_1: It is hard to explain. Of course, it's not a real song as you would understand it. I don't hear it with my ears, but rather, I feel it deep inside of me. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_10: Unfortunately, much of my understanding is instinctive, and our language just doesn't contain the right words for me to express the things I feel adequately.
npc.cerdras.multi_2: Calling it a song or melody is the best I can do to describe it to those who don't share this kind of perception. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_3: It also helps me to express and understand something for which our language has no appropriate expression. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_4: You know, we are so dependent on words that we can't think about concepts when we don't have words for them. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_5: I sometimes think words have become just as much of a hindrance as a help. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_6: Perhaps we would fare better if only we forgot words and dealt purely in feelings. Then perhaps all of us could hear the wonderful melody of nature.
npc.cerdras.multi_7: How can I explain my connection to the elements so that you can understand it? Hmmm, it is like a faint melody, a song, that is always there. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_8: I hear that melody shifting in time with the shifts in the elements. With so many years of listening, I have learned to interpret these shifts and so come to a deeper understanding of the elements. ...
npc.cerdras.multi_9: It was a natural step for me to become responsible for researching elemental lore. I try to learn as much as I can and share it with my fellow druids. ...
npc.cerdras.stdmod_1: I'm merely a humble druid like so many others here. I may not be the most talented of healers, but I am gifted with a special atunement to the elements.
npc.cerdras.stdmod_2: For me, nature is the harmony of the elements. This harmony can be disturbed by certain events, but nature always finds its way back to harmony in the end.
npc.chantalle.say_1: Oh my! You look so great in your uniform! You archpostmen are not only daring but also handsome. Here take it, that's the key you wanted. Just promise to visit me now and then!
npc.chantalle.say_2: Oh my, such a lovely necklace! Here take it, that's the key you wanted. Now let me admire my precious necklace alone.
npc.chantalle.say_3: I am sorry, I am not interested in your money. Maybe you should try your luck with Herbert, the postman instead.
npc.charles.greet_msg_1: Ahoy. Where can I sail you today?
npc.charles.multi_1: This passage is shorter and costs less gold - but on the other hand it is also a bit riskier. On this route there are frequent tempests and the severe winds may blow a passenger over board. ...
npc.charles.multi_2: Few ship captains would sail this route. But if you want to take the risk, I can bring you to Thais, Edron, Liberty Bay or Yalahar for less gold than usual. Interested?
npc.charles.say_1: Do you seek a shortcut passage to {Thais} for 100 gold, to {Edron} for 90 gold, to {Liberty Bay} for 20 gold or to {Yalahar} for 200 gold?
npc.charles.say_2: Set the sails and good luck to us!
npc.charles.stdmod_1: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
npc.charles.stdmod_3: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.charles.stdmod_4: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.charles.stdmod_5: Where do you want to go - {Thais}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Edron?}
npc.charles.stdmod_6: Where do you want to go - {Thais}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Edron?}
npc.charles.stdmod_7: Im the captain of the Poodle, the proudest ship on all oceans.
npc.charles.stdmod_8: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.charles.voice_1: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
npc.charlotta.greet_msg_1: Ah, welcome! Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! If you need druid spells, you've come to the right place. Otherwise it's just nice to have a visitor.
npc.charlotta.say_1: Oh, so you brought some gold from Eleonore to me?
npc.charlotta.say_2: Hmm, it seems that Eleonore does trust you. Perhaps she is even right. However. Since we need some help right now I guess we can't be too picky. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: 'peg leg'. She will tell you more about her problem.
npc.charos.greet_msg_1: Hello young friend! I can attune you to a city of your choice. If you step to the teleporter here you will not appear in the city you came from as usual, but the city of your choice. Is it what you wish?
npc.charos.say_1: [EN] Fine. You have {} \z attunements left. What is the new city of your choice? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Port Hope?
npc.charos.say_3: Sorry, I don't know about this place.
npc.charos.say_4: Fine. You have {} attunements left. What is the new city of your choice? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Port Hope?
npc.chartan.greet_msg_1: Great Znake forgive me to converze wiz ziz unworzy blankzkin.
npc.chartan.multi_1: You did it! Zere waz zome kind of zparkle and I zink it iz working again - oh pleaze feel free to try it, I uhm, I will wait here and be ready juzt in caze zomezing uhm happenz to you. ...
npc.chartan.multi_13: You being here meanz we have eztablished connectionz to ze zouz. Finally. And you are going to help uz. Well, zere iz zertainly a lot for you to do. Zo better get ztarted.
npc.chartan.multi_2: And if you head to Zalamon, be zure to inform him about our zituation. Food rationz are running low and we are ztill not well equipped. We need to eztablish a working zupply line.
npc.chartan.multi_3: Alright. Well, az you might not be aware of it yet - we are on top of an old temple complex. It haz been abandoned and it haz crumbled over time. ...
npc.chartan.multi_4: Ze teleporter over zere uzed to work juzt fine to get uz back to ze zouz. But it haz ztopped operating for quite zome time. ...
npc.chartan.multi_5: My men believe it iz a dizturbanze cauzed by ze corruption zat zpreadz everywhere. Zey are too zcared to go down zere. And zat'z where you come in. ...
npc.chartan.multi_6: Zere were meanz to activate teleporterz zomewhere in ze complex. But zinze you cannot reach all ze roomz, I guezz you will have to improvize. ...
npc.chartan.multi_7: Here iz ze key to ze entranze to ze complex. Figure zomezing out, reztore ze teleporter zo we can get back to ze plainz in ze zouz.
npc.chartan.multi_8: I zee. Zalamon zent word of ze arrival of a zoftzkin quite zome time ago. Zat muzt be you zen. ...
npc.chartan.multi_9: Well, I exzpected zomeone more - imprezzive. However, we will zee how far you can get. You've got newz from ze zouz? ...
npc.chartan.say_1: Mhm, what are you doing here. Who zent you?
npc.chartan.say_2: Zo are you ready to get zomezing done?
npc.chartan.say_3: Zo? Did you find a way to reztore ze teleporter?
npc.chavis.greet_msg_1: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
npc.chavis.say_1: Hey there, just to let you know - I am not a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will not feed themselves. ...
npc.chavis.say_10: Don't be fooled, we have here masters and servants like everywhere else. The whole system is a scam to subdue the masses, to fool them about what is really happening. ...
npc.chavis.say_11: The system only ensures that the rich have a better control and the labourers are only used.
npc.chavis.say_2: So in case you've got nothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my nose - please help us. ...
npc.chavis.say_3: If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - helping us, helps you in the long term, trust me.
npc.chavis.say_4: [EN] Don't be fooled, we have here masters and servants like everywhere else. The whole system is a scam to subdue the masses, to fool them about what is really happening. ...
npc.chavis.say_5: [EN] The system only ensures that the rich have a better control and the labourers are only used.
npc.chavis.say_6: They act so important but it is us common people who keep things going. There is a lot you can do in this city to earn a right to vote in the magistrate, though. So keep an eye out for everyone who needs help.
npc.chavis.say_7: I am sorry, you didn't harvest enough roots. You need to harvest a bundle of at least five roots - and please try doing it yourself.
npc.chavis.say_8: Yes? You brought some juicy roots? How nice of you - that's one additional voice in the {magistrate} of {Rathleton} for you! ...
npc.chavis.say_9: Spend it wisely, though, put in a word for the poor, will ye? Sure you will.
npc.chemar.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chemar.stdmod_1: Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.stdmod_3: Never heard about a place like this.
npc.chemar.stdmod_4: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
npc.chemar.voice_1: Ask me if you need letters or parcels. I'll deliver them via airmail, of course!
npc.chemar.voice_2: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.chemar.walkaway_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_1: Great, you are here. We need your service in a mission of utmost urgency ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_10: Just recently we were able to secretly help our elven friends to exposure an agitator sent by Carlin to poison our connections with them. The elves' reaction wasswift and without compromise ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_11: They banished the delinquent in a place they call 'Hellgate'. Unfortunately, we learnt later that the convict was sent there with several of his belongings and it is very likely that he took vital papers with him ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_12: These papers can tell us much about Carlin's plans in the North. We need you to enter 'Hellgate' and to retrieve the papers for us ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_13: We don't care how you get them. Do whatever you think is necessary.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_14: One of our agents is missing. He was investigating the cause for the slow growth of our colony Port Hope ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_15: You will continue these investigations at the point where the information that the lost agent has sent us ends. Some of the traders in Port Hope must have connections to persons who are interested in sabotaging our efforts in Tiquanda ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_16: Search their personal belongings to find some sort of evidence that we could need!
npc.chester_kahs.multi_17: Your next mission concerns an internal matter for our agency. Some decades ago, one of our most talented field agents vanished in the Green Claw Swamp ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_18: Nowadays, that more and more adventurers are swarming this area, there is an increasing number of reports on some sinister goings-on and mysterious ruins in the middle of the swamp ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_19: We got some credible clues that there might be a connection between the ruins and the disappearance of our agent ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_2: A mad dwarven technomancer that listens to the name of Blowbeard sent us a blackmailing letter. He demands to deliver all of Thais's gold to him. Else he will destroy the city with an artificial earthquake caused by one of his machines! ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_20: As he is already missing since decades it is unlikely that he is still alive. Nevertheless, we want you to find out something about the whereabouts of our agent in the ruins in the Green Claw Swamp, north west of Venore ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_21: He used to write diaries, maybe you can find one of those, or some other hints, or even his remains. You have to understand that he was a member of a prestigious Thaian family. Very influential people are interested in his whereabouts ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_22: The Green Claw Swamp is treacherous and dangerous. You will have a hard time to find any clues ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_23: As a small incentive I think its worthy to mention that he was wearing a quite impressive armor. You may keep it for yourself if you stumble across it.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_24: Your first task is to deliver a warning. Illegally, the Venoreans are crafting more ships than the Thaian authorities have allowed them ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_25: Our sources have told us that those ships often end up in the hands of pirates or smugglers ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_26: An official note would strain the relationship between Thais and Venore too much as this would mean that we had to admit officially that we know about those activities ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_27: Still, we can't allow them to continue like this. It will be your task to let them know that we do not tolerate such behaviour. Get a fire bug from Liberty Bay and set their shipyard on fire ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_28: Use the fire bug on some flammable material there to start the fire. It might take a while to find some wood that's dry enough for the fire to spread. Just keep trying ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_29: If you get captured or killed during your mission, we will deny any contact with you.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_3: We need you to find his base in Kazordoon and to kill him before he can use his infernal machine. Bring us his beard as proof of your success.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_30: Our bureau is an old and traditional branch of the Thaian government. It takes more than lip service to join our ranks ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_31: Absolute loyalty to the crown and the Thaian cause as well as courage face-to-face with the enemy is the least we expect from our members ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_32: You will swear allegiance to Thais alone and abandon the service of any other city. So is it really your wish to become one of our field agents?
npc.chester_kahs.multi_4: The women of Carlin have the northern city Svargrond in the firm grip of her manicured hands. At the moment, there is little we can do about it but there is one thing that plays into our hands ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_5: The barbarians have surely at least heard about the fact that alcohol is outlawed in Carlin ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_6: If some amazonian warrior would smash a beer or ale cask in front of some witnesses, the relationship would surely suffer a bit. So go and disguise yourself as an amazon. Then use a crowbar to destroy a cask.
npc.chester_kahs.multi_7: It's bad enough that Carlin got a solid foothold in the far North but now the Venoreans also try to move in. They try to gain influence on the barbarian raiders by bribing their leaders or making them great promises ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_8: We want you to cause some bad blood in this relationship. Travel to their most southern camp, enter the ice tower of their leaders and kill some of them ...
npc.chester_kahs.multi_9: Here is a signet ring that the Venorean emissaries use to wear. 'Lose' the ring in the north-western corner of the highest level of the tower. They will surely find it there.
npc.chester_kahs.say_1: Are you saying that Gamel is a member of the rebellion?
npc.chester_kahs.say_10: Please bring me some proof of his whereabouts.
npc.chester_kahs.say_11: I can only hope that this information are as valuable as we expected it. A good man died for them.
npc.chester_kahs.say_12: Please bring me some valuable information!
npc.chester_kahs.say_13: Ah yes, very interesting. Almost as I suspected. It's a good thing that we got those documents in our hands.
npc.chester_kahs.say_14: We need those intelligence reports, do whatever you need to do agent!
npc.chester_kahs.say_15: Now that Venore is of nearly no importance anymore, there is only Carlin left to deal with.
npc.chester_kahs.say_16: I already heard that our little trick worked quite well. Several officials of Carlin are already on their way to repair the damage done to their diplomatic efforts. It will not only cost them much money but also quite some time.
npc.chester_kahs.say_17: Here you are. Better don't loose it again.
npc.chester_kahs.say_19: You have done superb work agent, I grant you the title of Top Agent! Here's a little gift you might find useful.
npc.chester_kahs.say_2: Do you know what his plans are about?
npc.chester_kahs.say_20: Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.chester_kahs.say_21: Then don't bother me with it. I'm a busy man.
npc.chester_kahs.say_24: That's terrible! Will you give me the crystal?
npc.chester_kahs.say_25: Tell me precisely what he asked you to do! It's important!
npc.chester_kahs.say_26: Do you need the healing now?
npc.chester_kahs.say_27: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_28: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_29: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_3: Thank you! Take this ring. If you ever need a healing, come, bring the scroll, and ask me to {heal}.
npc.chester_kahs.say_30: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_31: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_32: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_33: Have you fulfilled your current mission?
npc.chester_kahs.say_34: If you lost or wasted your disguise kit I can replace it. It will cost you 1000 gold though since you lost royal property. Is that ok for you?
npc.chester_kahs.say_7: Then I welcome you to the TBI. This is a great moment for you, remember it well. Talk to me about your missions whenever you feel ready.
npc.chester_kahs.say_8: I think they understood the warning the way it was meant. If not, you will have to visit Venore soon again. But for now it's settled.
npc.chester_kahs.say_9: I can only hope that this information are as valuable as we expected it. A good man died for them.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_1: Too many possibilities to become a servant of darkness to trust ANYONE!
npc.chester_kahs.voice_2: Don't tell me I didn't warn you.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_3: It's all a big conspiracy, mark my words.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_4: Not everything that walks our streets is human ... or even living.
npc.chester_kahs.voice_5: We are surrounded by myths, living and dead.
npc.chief_grarkharok.say_1: Hahaha! Grarkharok take cloak from pretty girl. Then ... girl is swan. Grarkharok wants eat but flies away. Grarkharok not understand. Not need cloak, too many feathers. Give cloak to To ... Ta ... Tereban in Edron. Getting shiny coins and meat.
npc.chief_grarkharok.say_10: You no have tasty snake! Bring tasty snake!!! Grarkharok hungry!!
npc.chief_grarkharok.say_11: |PLAYERNAME|?!? Sound good! Bring troll lady to Grarkharok!! Here, give troll lady! Take take! Bring lady to Grarkharok for make tribe!! Now GO!
npc.chief_grarkharok.say_14: Grarkharok angry now!! Want throw rock on human cave down hill again!

npc.cipfried.greet_msg_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds. It's my job after all.
npc.cipfried.greet_msg_2: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! I'll {heal} you if you are injured or poisoned. Feel free to ask me for {help} or general {hints}.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_1: Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_2: Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_1: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_10: Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_11: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {monsters}, {quests} and {citizens} around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_12: How can I help you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_13: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_14: I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_15: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_16: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisonous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_17: If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_18: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_19: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_2: Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_20: Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_21: Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_22: Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_23: Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_24: You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_25: You can buy equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {gold}. Some {monsters} also carry equipment pieces with them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_26: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
npc.cipfried.stdmod_27: Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_28: To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_29: Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {monster}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_3: Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_30: As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_31: Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_32: The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_33: Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_34: The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will help you if you ask them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_35: They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_36: Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_37: You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_38: The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_39: I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_40: To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_41: You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_42: Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_43: Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_44: I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_45: You are poisoned. I will help you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_47: You aren't looking really bad, |PLAYERNAME|. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating {food}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_48: Obi's {shop} is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} sells {armor} and {shields} upstairs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_49: She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_50: That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_51: I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_52: That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_53: In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_54: Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced {explorer} and {adventurer}. It's always interesting to chat with her.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_55: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_56: Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell {food} there.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_58: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_59: Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_6: Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {help} or {healing}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_60: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_61: You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_62: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_8: I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to help newcomers in this world.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_9: You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get {killed}. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
npc.cipfried.voice_1: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
npc.cipfried.voice_2: Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.voice_3: Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!

npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_1: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_2: Welcome stranger! You might be surprised that I don't attack you immediately. The point is, that I think you could be useful to me. What you see in front of you is a great mine of the corym! ...
npc.corym_ratter.greet_msg_3: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources. But the yield is getting worse and here I need your {help}.
npc.corym_ratter.say_1: Recently the amount of delivered ores is decreasing. Could you find out the reason, why the situation has become worse?
npc.corym_ratter.say_2: Nice! I have opened the mine for you. But take care of you! The monsters of depth won't spare you.
npc.corym_ratter.say_3: Recently the amount of delivered ores is decreasing. Could you find out the reason, why the situation has become worse?

npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_1: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_2: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_3: Well, I see you have already collected enough rare earth! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_4: You have to liberate all the Corym I told you. Unlock the three affected areas.
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_5: Well done! The riot progesses! No fight without weapons. In the mine the temperature is quite high, higher as expected in this depth. Therefore we need heat-resistent weapons and armors. ...
npc.corym_servant.greet_msg_6: This effect can be reached by adding rare earth to the common materials. But this can only be found in the stomaches of stonerefiners. 20 of these should be enough. Well, I see you have already collected enough of them! Would you give it to me?
npc.corym_servant.multi_1: Thank you very much! Our smiths are now able to craft heat-resistent weapons and armor. A little reward for you is this. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_2: There is one last thing I would like to say to you, there are rumours that this dungeon can only be entered alive. This could mean that there's an unknown dungeon keeper guarding this place, so take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.multi_3: I see you are interested to change our sitation. The first thing I like you to do is to liberate the jailed coryms. There are three areas with locked doors. You have to find a way to get access. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_4: For this reason I will give you access to the second floor. It was closed because it wasn't possible to continue working at these enourmous high temperatures. Furthermore we were instantly attacked by stonerefiners. So take care of you!
npc.corym_servant.multi_5: You have to know, that our work is very hard and the conditions we have are terrible. The wanted amount is abolutely unrealistic. Beyond that the food we get is never enough. ...
npc.corym_servant.multi_6: Our workers should give their best while starving. This is not possible. That's the point to {defy} the authority.

npc.costello.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Feel free to tell me what has brought you here.
npc.costello.say_1: [EN] To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. \z Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. \z Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
npc.costello.say_2: Who are you to demand holy water from the White Raven Monastery? Who sent you??
npc.costello.say_3: I already filled your vial with holy water.
npc.costello.say_4: Ahh, Amanda from Edron sent you! I hope she's doing well. So why did she send you here?
npc.costello.say_5: Thank you very much! From now on you may open the warded doors to the catacombs.
npc.costello.say_7: By the gods! This is brother Fugio's handwriting and what I read is horrible indeed! You have done our order a great favour by giving this diary to me! Take this blessed Ankh. May it protect you in even your darkest hours.
npc.costello.say_8: I never heard that name and you won't get holy water for some stranger.
npc.costello.say_9: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.
npc.costello.say_fugio: To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
