npc.curos.multi_1: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...
npc.curos.multi_10: So you still think you can be of any use for us? Words are cheap and easy. Admittedly, you've passed our first test but even some resilient beast might have accomplished that. ...
npc.curos.multi_11: Your actions will tell if you are only yelping for attention like a puppy or if you have the teeth of a wolf. ...
npc.curos.multi_12: A first tiny step was taken. You survived the test and ensured the survival of your allies for a while. Now it is time to make the next step. ...
npc.curos.multi_13: So listen human: Our rule over the orcs is not unchallenged. Of course now and then someone shows up who thinks he can defeat us. Usually these fights end fast and bloody in the ring. ...
npc.curos.multi_14: Right now, some coward from our midst, who is too afraid to face us in single combat, has gathered a group of followers, hoping more will follow and change sides. ...
npc.curos.multi_15: With your help, his defeat will not only be deadly but also humiliating and so discourage others to follow his example. ...
npc.curos.multi_16: You will seek out this rebel commander in his hideout and kill him. We will show them that not even a Mooh'Tah master is needed to get rid of such wannabe leaders but that a mere human can handle them. ...
npc.curos.multi_17: Find him in the mountain north-west of here and kill him. If you find any loot, you can keep it.
npc.curos.multi_18: We have seen that you can fight and survive. Yet, it will also need cleverness and courage to survive in these lands. We might see later if you've got what it takes. ...
npc.curos.multi_19: However, I stand to my word - our hordes will spare your insignificant piece of rock for now. Time will tell if you are worthy living next to us. ...
npc.curos.multi_2: Face him in a battle and survive for two minutes. If you do, we will be willing to assume that your are prepared for the life in these lands. Enter the ring of battle, close to my quarter. Return to me after you have passed this test.
npc.curos.multi_20: Still, it will take years until we might consider you as an ally, but this is a start at least.
npc.curos.multi_3: Finally, our enemy's vision is obscured. Now we can move in for some more daring raids until they replace their scrying device. You have proven yourself brave and useful so far. With that, you bought your allies some more days to live. ...
npc.curos.multi_4: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.
npc.curos.multi_5: We are aware that the lizards use magic to spy on us. In the Dragonblaze Mountains north of here, there is a tower which can only be entered through one of their underground fortresses. ...
npc.curos.multi_6: In this tower, there must be some accessory used for magical scrying. Some pond, a crystal ball, or a mirror maybe - it has to be something shiny. ...
npc.curos.multi_7: Usually we would send one of our youngsters on such a mission, but we are few and there is little new blood in our ranks. ...
npc.curos.multi_8: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...
npc.curos.multi_9: This is your chance to show us your potential. Infiltrate this tower and destroy their scrying device. Once you have blinded our enemy, we might respect you somewhat more.
npc.curos.say_1: You come here to ask us to spare your people? This land has no tolerance for the weak, we have it neither. If you want us to consider you as useful for us, you'll have to prove it in a {test} of strength and courage.
npc.curos.say_2: With the death of their leader, the rebels return to our camps one by one, deeply humiliated. It might be a wise decision to let a useful tool like you continue to exist.
npc.dalbrect.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to my {hut}.
npc.dalbrect.say_1: [EN] Can it be? I recognise my family's arms! You have found a treasure indeed! \z I am poor and all I can offer you is my friendship, but ... please ... give that brooch to me?
npc.dalbrect.say_2: [EN] Thank you! I shall consider you my friend from now on! \z Just let me know if you {need} something!
npc.dalbrect.say_3: What are you talking about? I am too poor to be interested in jewelry.
npc.dalbrect.say_4: I should have known better than to ask for an act of kindness in this cruel, selfish, world!
npc.dalbrect.say_5: Then stop being a fool. I am poor and I have to work the whole day through!
npc.dalbrect.say_6: I should have known better than to ask for an act of kindness in this cruel, selfish, world!
npc.dalbrect.say_7: Can it be? I recognise my family's arms! You have found a treasure indeed! I am poor and all I can offer you is my friendship, but ... please ... give that brooch to me?
npc.dalbrect.say_8: Thank you! I shall consider you my friend from now on! Just let me know if you {need} something!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_1:
I have only sailed to the isle of the kings once or twice. \z
				I dare not anger the monks by bringing travelers there without their permission.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_10:
Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_11:
Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. \z
				Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. \z
				If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_12: To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge!
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_13:
There is little I can offer you but a trip with my boat. \z
				Are you looking for a {passage} to the isle of kings perhaps?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_2: Do you seek a passage to the isle of the kings for 10 gold coins?
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_4: Well, I'll be here if you change your mind.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_5: My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud Windtrouser family.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_6: I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble {legacy}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_7: Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but {fate} turned against us and threw us into poverty.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_8:
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dalbrect.stdmod_9:
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
npc.dallheim.greet_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.greet_2: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_1: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_11: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_12: My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_13: Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_15: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_16: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_17: I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_18: Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_19: There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_2: Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_20: Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_21: You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_22: Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_23: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_24: They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_25: The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_26: A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_27: Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_28: Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_29: Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_3: I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_31: All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_32: A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_33: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_34: The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_35: There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_37: The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
npc.dallheim.stdmod_38: I'm not interested in such party tricks.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_39: A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_4: Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_40: It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_41: It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_42: Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_43: I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_44: Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_45: He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_47: He has been on this island as long as me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_49: He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_50: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_51: Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_52: Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_53: Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_54: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_6: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_7: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.dallheim.stdmod_9: Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.dallheim.voice_1: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
npc.dallheim.voice_2: Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.dallheim.voice_3: I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
npc.dallheim.voice_4: Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.dancing_fairy.farewell_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_1: That's very kind of you, my friend! Listen: I know there is a spell to transform my fishtail into legs. It is a temporary effect, so I could return to the ocean as soon as the spell ends. Unfortunately I don't know how to cast this spell. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_2: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_3: Each of those notes will grant her a walk on the beach with Taegen.
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_4: So, you are searching for a way to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. As you might already have figured out you need some magic for this purpose. There is a place on Feyrist where you can find the arcane energies you need. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_5: Northeast from here you'll discover a big lake with a small island. Take a swim there and you will find a magical fountain. If you play the panpipes while standing near this fountain, you will create some magical music notes. ...
npc.dancing_fairy.multi_6: Collect them and give them to Aurita. Each of those notes will grant her a walk on the beach with Taegen.
npc.dancing_fairy.walkaway_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.dane.farewell_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.dane.stdmod_1: I am the owner of this place of relaxation.
npc.dane.stdmod_5: I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade.
npc.dane.stdmod_6: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_7: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.dane.stdmod_8: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_1: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_10: It's not only the trolls invading from the west coast. <sighs> Goblins also have a lair there where they constantly prepare for their next attack. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_11: If you could kill 150 goblins for us, that'd be a good start. Would you be willing to help us in this matter?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_12: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_13: I want you to kill 100 of them. If you succeed, I'll provide you some pretty coins and experience. Are you willing to take on this task?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_2: Exit the city and go through a mountain passage leading to the west, then keep on heading north. The entrance is marked by large, obelisk-like stones arranged in a circle. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_3: You can kill normal cyclopes as well as drones and smiths to reach your goal. Good hunting!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_4: Great! You can find rotworms south of the city, for example. Take a rope and shovel and look for loose stone piles to dig open. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_5: You can kill normal rotworms as well as their larger brothers, the carrion worms, to fulfil your task. Be careful and good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_6: Very well, maybe you know that the orcs here in Edron learnt to raise giant spiders. It is going to become a serious threat. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_7: The mission is simple: go to the orcs and destroy all spider eggs that are hatched by the giant spider they have managed to catch. The orcs are located in the south of the western part of the island.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_8: We've successfully driven the minotaurs off this island, but the underground city of the cyclopes - Cyclopolis - is still standing. ...
npc.daniel_steelsoul.multi_9: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_1: [EN] Your current task is to kill 100 trolls. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_10: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To reach your goal, you have to kill the brown trolls and troll champions. Good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_11: Fine then! You can kill normal goblins as well as scavengers and assassins on the lower levels, but beware, they are a bit harder. Have a good hunt!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_12: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_13: Fine then! I'll show you the Goblin den on your map, here. Use the same passage you did when hunting for trolls. You can kill normal goblins as well as scavengers and assassins on the lower levels, but beware, they are a bit harder.
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_14: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 150 goblins. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_15: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to repeat killing 100 trolls. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_16: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 500 cyclops. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_17: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 300 rotworms. Would that suit your taste better?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_18: Your current task is to kill 100 trolls. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_19: Your current task is to kill 150 goblins. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_2: [EN] Your current task is to kill 150 goblins. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_20: Your current task is to kill 300 rotworms. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_21: Your current task is to kill 500 cyclops. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_3: [EN] Your current task is to kill 300 rotworms. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_4: [EN] Your current task is to kill 500 cyclops. You have already killed {} of them. Keep going!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_5: Congratulations, you've fought well against the goblin plague. Thank you! Here is your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_6: Well done! Thanks to you the city is a bit safer. Here's your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_7: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_8: Currently there is no new task I could entrust you with. However, you can repeat killing {goblins} or {trolls}. Which would you prefer?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.say_9: Maybe you have noticed the numerous rotworms that burrowed under Edron. They're quite a pest. You look strong enough to be able to vanquish a few for us. Do you think you can kill 300 rotworms?
npc.daniel_steelsoul.stdmod_1: I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
npc.dario.greet_1: Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.greet_msg_1: Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.
npc.dario.voice_1: Increase your knowledge of spells here, young paladin.
npc.dario.voice_2: Need ammunition, bows or crossbows? Have a look at my wares.
npc.dedoras.greet_msg_1: Greetings seekers of knowledge. You seem to be just the person I'm {looking} for.
npc.dedoras.multi_1: Marvellous! With this information combined we have all that's needed! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_10: There's a beautiful but very dangerous palace in the Tiquandan jungle. The young women who live there are actually demons and they are luring unsuspecting mortals in there. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_11: A lucky survivor told me about a portal at the very top of the palace that may lead to another asuri hideout.
npc.dedoras.multi_12: Our world has seen many noble knights and orders throughout the centuries. Most of them vanished a long time ago but only few under such mysterious circumstances as the Order of the Falcon. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_13: This noble alliance of honourable knights once resided in Edron to serve the king. Legend has it they vanished practically over night. Rumor has it their disappearance is connected to a forbidden book.
npc.dedoras.multi_14: Sightings of strange fishmen in Tiquanda are stirring up the region. You should be careful when investigating this. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_15: As far as I know a scholar in Edron already dealt with fish-like creatures before.
npc.dedoras.multi_17: An astonishing find to say the least! I'm certain it will help the efforts of accessing the library a lot!
npc.dedoras.multi_18: I gathered some lore on my own, but I desperately need more information that you might provide me. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_19: My leads are the {museum} in thais, something strange in the darashian {desert}, rumors about {fishmen}, an ancient {order}, the mysterious {asuri}, or a lost {isle}?
npc.dedoras.multi_3: Hmm, interesting. And we shouldn't forget about the chant! Yes, excellent! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_4: So listen: To enter the veiled library, travel to the white raven monastery on the Isle of Kings and enter its main altar room. ...
npc.dedoras.multi_5: There, use an ordinary scythe on the right of the two monuments, while concentrating on this glyph here and chant the words: Chamek Athra Thull Zathroth ...
npc.dedoras.multi_6: Oh, and one other thing. For your efforts I want to reward you with one of my old outfits, back from my adventuring days. May it suit you well! ...
npc.dedoras.multi_7: Hurry now my friend. Time is of essence!
npc.dedoras.multi_8: [EN] Or shall me {check} how much information we acquired?
npc.dedoras.multi_9: Or shall me {check} how much information we acquired?
npc.dedoras.say_1: I have heard that it was recently planned to expand the Museum of Tibian Arts. In the course of these activities unexpected difficulties occurred.
npc.dedoras.say_10: Are you interested in one or two addons to your battle mage outfit?
npc.dedoras.say_11: Very good! You gained the first addon to the battle mage outfit.
npc.dedoras.say_12: Very good! You gained the second addon to the battle mage outfit.
npc.dedoras.say_13: I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me five sturdy books. For the second addon you need twenty epaulettes. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.dedoras.say_14: What do you have for me: the sturdy books or the epaulettes?
npc.dedoras.say_2: That's simply a scientific sensation. It will provide me with lots of much needed knowledge!
npc.dedoras.say_3: There are rumors of a mysterious statue in the desert next to Darashia. Nobody really knows the meaning of it.
npc.dedoras.say_4: You brought incredible news. This book proves an invaluable clue!
npc.dedoras.say_5: You brought incredible news. This book proves an invaluable clue!
npc.dedoras.say_6: This is incredible! Thank you so much for digging out that hint!
npc.dedoras.say_7: Thank you so much for your efforts to provide this valuable piece of the puzzle!
npc.dedoras.say_8: Talk to Captain Charles in Port Hope. He told me that he once ran ashore on a small island where he discovered a small ruin. The architecture was like nothing he had seen before.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_1: I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_10:
Hints about the shrouded hoard are numerous, though most are general mentions in texts that deal with Zathroth. But there are other sources. ... \z
	Like texts about ancient liturgies of Zathroth and historical documents that might give us clues. I already compiled everything of value from the sources that were openly available. ... \z
	To gather the more {obscure} parts of knowledge, however, I'll need your help.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_11:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_12:
The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ... \z
	The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ... \z
	The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_13:
Of course the dangers of such knowledge were obvious. It was hidden in a sacred place devoted to Zathroth and dangerous knowledge. ... \z
	The hidden library, the forbidden hoard, the shrouded trove of knowledge or the veiled hoard of forbidden knowledge, the place has many names in many {myths}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_14:
Regardless of the dangers, the cult of Zathroth refused to destroy the knowledge of the godbreaker for good. ... \z
	They {value} dangerous knowledge that much, that they are unable to part from it, even when faced with the utter destruction of creation.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_15:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_16:
I'd recommend to follow the few leads me and my associates could gather so far. ... \z
	Old myths, some {rumors} about old texts and other pieces of knowledge that I could use to figure out where to locate the hidden library and how to enter it.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_2: This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_3: I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_4: The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_5: Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_6: You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_7:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_8:
The godbreaker is a complex artifact. Incantation woven into incantation. The powers bound into it are so immense that the slightest mishandling could prove disastrous. ... \z
	o figure out how it works, let alone how it can be operated safely, could require several centuries of tireless study. And even then this information would be only partial. ... \z
	Yet the creation and operation of the godbreaker is just the kind of forbidden {knowledge} Zathroth values most, so it was compiled and stored.
npc.dedoras.stdmod_9:
The myths agree that the place is well hidden, extremely guarded and contains some of the most powerful pieces of knowledge in this world and probably beyond. ... \z
	However the knowledge about the godbreaker now poses a threat to all existence. In the hands of Variphor it can cause disaster in previously unknown ways. The gods themselves are in {peril}.
