npc.gnomegica.voice_1: Oh my, such a mess! I really should clean up things more often.
npc.gnomelvis.greet_msg_1: Hello. Is it me you're {looking} for?
npc.gnomelvis.multi_1: Congratulations on finding your soul melody. And a pretty one as far as I can tell. Now you are a true recruit of the Bigfoot company! Commander Stone might have some tasks for you to do! ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_2: Look for him in the central chamber. I marked your map where you will find him.
npc.gnomelvis.multi_3: Ah well. Everyone has a very personal melody in his soul. Only if you know your soul melody then you know yourself. And only if you know yourself will you be admitted to the Bigfoot company. ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_4: So what you have to do is to find your soul melody. Do you see the huge crystals in this room? Those are harmonic crystals. Use them to deduce your soul melody. Simply use them to create a sound sequence. ...
npc.gnomelvis.multi_5: Every soul melody consists of seven sound sequences. You will have to figure out your correct soul melody by trial and error. If you hit a wrong note, you will have to start over.
npc.gnomelvis.say_2: What you have to do is to find your soul melody. Use the harmonic crystals to deduce your soul melody. Every soul melody consists of seven sound sequences. ...
npc.gnomelvis.say_3: You will have to figure out your correct soul melody by trial and error.
npc.gnomelvis.say_4: Congratulations on finding your soul melody.
npc.gnomeral.multi_1: We gnomes need some special grindstones to cut and polish specific crystals. The thing is, they can only be found in a quite dangerous lava cave full of vile monsters. You'll reach it via the hot spot teleporter. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_10: Be that as it may, in this package you'll find a crystal. Take it out of the package and go to the crystal caves to find it a mate. Just look out for huge red crystals and try your luck. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_11: They should look like one of those seen in your soul melody test. You will find them in the crystal grounds. {Report} back to me when you are done.
npc.gnomeral.multi_2: It will be your task to get one such grindstone and bring it back to me.
npc.gnomeral.multi_3: We gnomes want you to gather a special collection of spores. All you have to do is use a puffball mushroom and use the spore gathering kit I gave you to gather the spores. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_4: There is a catch though. You need to collect different spores in a specific sequence to fill your gathering kit. If you mix the spores in the wrong way, you ruin your collection and have to start over. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_5: You have to gather them in this sequence: red, green, blue and yellow. You can see on your kit what is required next.
npc.gnomeral.multi_6: I'm no expert on how those golems work, but it seems that when the crystals of the golems get out of harmony, they do as they please and even sometimes become violent. The violent ones are lost. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_7: Don't bother with them, though you may decide to kill some to get rid of them. The others can be repaired, but to recall them to the workshops, the golems have to be put into a specific resonance. ...
npc.gnomeral.multi_8: Use the bell I gave you on the golems, so the gnomes can recall them to their workshops. Getting four of them should be enough for now. Report back when you are ready.
npc.gnomeral.multi_9: You will have to find a lonely crystal a perfect match. I don't understand the specifics but the gnomes told me that even crystals need a mate to produce offspring. ...

npc.gnomercy.multi_1: With your help and efforts we finally cornered what we think is one of 'those below'! For all you have done and endured you are granted the privilege to be one of the first to fight the true enemy. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_2: For all we know your successes have brought some unrest to our enemies and they sent one of their observers to punish their slaves and force them to more fierce attacks. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_3: This is our chance to deal the enemy the first blow in this conflict. With reinforcements from Gnomehome we are attacking the troops of the enemy and binding a great deal of their forces in battle. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_4: Now it is up to you to fight your way to the heart of the enemy's defences and kill the observer. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_5: Our first tries were met with no success though. The observer has brought with him one of his creatures or lieutenants, the lost call the thing Versperoth. I am not sure if it is a name or a race. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_6: However Versperoth itself is protected by hoards of minions. Sometimes this thing will withdraw into the ground and let all hell loose in form of its' slaves. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_7: You'd better be finished with them before Versperoth re-emerges. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_8: Only when you manage to kill Versperoth, will you be able to enter the portal behind him and face the true evil of the observer. ...
npc.gnomercy.multi_9: Use the GREEN command crystal in the cave to begin the charging of the teleport! Good luck.

npc.gnomerik.say_23: That's the spirit! But let us continue with the {test}.
npc.gnomerik.say_25: Stop it! The test is over, you can ask me for your {results}.

npc.gnomerik.say_28: Oh, you silver tongued devil almost made me blush. But of course you're right. But let us continue with the {test}.
npc.gnomerik.say_29: How true. How true. *sigh* But fear not! We gnomes are here to help! But let us continue with the {test}.
npc.gnomerik.say_3: We are hiring people to fight in our so called Bigfoot company against the foes of gnomekind. Are you interested in joining?

npc.gnomewart.multi_1: Ah, the test is a piece of mushroomcake! Just take the teleporter over there in the south and follow the hallway. ...
npc.gnomewart.multi_2: You'll need to run quite a bit. It is important that you don't give up! Just keep running and running and running and ... I guess you got the idea. ...

npc.gnomillion.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.gnomillion.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.gnomilly.multi_1: We need you to recharge our ghost pacifiers. They are placed at several strategic points in the caves around us and should be easy to find. Your mission would be to charge seven of them.
npc.gnomilly.multi_2: If you are interested, I can give you some more {information} about it. Are you willing to accept this mission?
npc.gnomilly.multi_3: On these levels we found evidence of some monumental battle that has taken place here centuries ago. We also found some grave sites, but oddly enough no clues of any form of settlement. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_4: Some evidence we have found suggests that at least one of the battles here was fought for many, many years. People came here, lived here, fought here and died here. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_5: The battles continued until someone or something literally ploughed through the battlefields, turning everything upside down. All this killing and death soaked the area with negative energy. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_6: Necromantic forces are running wild all over the place and we are hard-pressed to drive all these undead, spirits and ghosts, away from the Spike. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_7: Unless we can secure that area somehow, the Spike operation is threatened to become crippled by the constant attacks of the undead. ...
npc.gnomilly.multi_8: The whole growing downwards could come to a halt, leaving us exposed to even more attacks, counter attacks, and giving the enemy time to prepare their defences. There's a lot to do for aspiring adventurers.

npc.gnomission.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|. You are probably eager to enter the {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.multi_1: You can trade special spoils of war to get a permission to use the war teleporters to the area of the corresponding boss without need of mission crystals. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_2: Which one would you like to trade: the deathstrike's {snippet}, gnomevil's {hat} or the abyssador {lash}?
npc.gnomission.multi_3: There are three warzones. In each warzone you will find fearsome foes. At the end you'll find their mean master. The masters is well protected though. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_4: Make sure to talk to our gnomish agent in there for specifics of its' protection. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_5: Oh, and to be able to enter the second warzone you have to best the first. To enter the third you have to best the second. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_6: And you can enter each one only once every twenty hours. Your normal teleport crystals won't work on these teleporters. You will have to get {mission} crystals from Gnomally.
npc.gnomission.say_1: I am responsible for our war {missions}, to {trade} with seasoned soldiers and rewarding war {heroes}. You have to be rank 4 to enter the {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.say_10: I can't let you enter the warzone teleporter three for free, unless you handle me a Gnomevil's hat. But can still always use a red teleport crystal.
npc.gnomission.say_11: You need to defeat the second warzone boss to be able to get free access to the third warzone.
npc.gnomission.say_12: It seems you did not even set one big foot into the warzone, I am sorry.
npc.gnomission.say_13: Fine, I grant you the permission to enter the warzones. Be warned though, this will be not a picnic. Better bring some friends with you. Bringing a lot of them sounds like a good idea.
npc.gnomission.say_14: You have already accepted this mission.
npc.gnomission.say_15: Sorry, you have not yet earned enough renown that we would risk your life in such a dangerous mission.
npc.gnomission.say_16: Only if you have killed 20 of our major enemies in the warzones I am allowed to trade with you.
npc.gnomission.say_2: As a war hero you are allowed to use the warzone teleporter one for free!
npc.gnomission.say_3: I can't let you enter the warzone teleporter one for free, unless you handle me a Deathstrike's snippet. But can still always use a red teleport crystal.
npc.gnomission.say_5: As a war hero you are allowed to use the warzone teleporter three for free!

npc.gnommander.speech_1: I'm the operating commander of the Spike, the latest great accomplishment of the gnomish race.
npc.gnommander.speech_2: The Spike is a crystal structure, created by our greatest crystal experts. It has grown from a crystal the size of my fist to the structure you see here and now.
npc.gnommander.speech_3: Of course this did not happen from one day to the other. It's the fruit of the work of several gnomish generations. Its purpose has changed in the course of time.
npc.gnommander.speech_4: At first it was conceived as a fast growing resource node. Then it was planned to become the prototype of a new type of high security base.
npc.gnommander.speech_5: Now it has become a military base and a weapon. With our foes occupied elsewhere, we can prepare our strike into the depths of the earth.
npc.gnommander.speech_6: This crystal can withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and it's growing deeper and deeper even as we speak.
npc.gnommander.speech_7: The times of the fastest growth have come to an end, however, and we have to slow down in order not to risk the structural integrity of the Spike. But we are on our way and have to do everything possible to defend the Spike.
npc.gnomole.greet_msg_1: Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
npc.gnomole.multi_1: Since you are seasoned adventurers I'll skip the basics and jump right to the important part! This cave system is overrun by the minions of ... ah well, the greatest shame of gnomekind. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_2: That traitorous gnome, known as Gnomevil, who was my pupil before his changeover to the dark side of gnomedom, has abandoned all gnomish ethics and joined forces with our enemies. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_3: It's hard to tell what led to his downfall. In the end he seems to have forgotten the principle that with small stature comes great responsibility. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_4: He became tainted and corrupted by evil, obviously enough to grow in size, which is always an indicator for evil of course. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_5: Now he commands his armies in the name of those below and hides in his lair protected by layers of thick crystal that only he can form and change due to his corrupted powers! ...
npc.gnomole.multi_6: There is one thing though that could cause his downfall! His corruption has spread to his minions and in his lair there are some infected weepers that are full of parasites. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_7: These parasites will spread a fluid that will weaken the integrity of the crystals in front of Gnomevils lair when they die. The entrance is marked with crystal columns, so you can't miss it. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_8: You have to kill enough of the parasites DIRECTLY in front of the crystals. Eventually the columns will collapse and allow you entrance to Gnomevils lair. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_9: Take care though, due to Gnomevils power the crystals will grow back quite fast. Better manage the parasites in quick succession or everything will be for naught. ..., Enter his lair and bring an end to his despicable reign!
npc.gnomus.greet_msg_1: Greetings, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. We could really use some {help} from you right now. You should prove {worthy} to our alliance.
npc.gnomus.multi_1: Very good. We prepared a lot of maps as the complete mapping of this system will probably take a lot of research. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_10: As we have our hands full with a lot of things right now, we could need someone to chart the unknown parts of this underground labyrinth ...
npc.gnomus.multi_11: I am especially interested in the scattered dark structures around these parts. Would you do that?
npc.gnomus.multi_12: Excellent, just follow the path to east until you reach a dead end, there is a hole that leads to a small cave underneath which will bring you right to the old trail. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_13: Help whoever you can and return them to the save cave exit - oh, and while you're at it... some of them will have pack animals. If you can rescue those as well, I'll hand you a bonus. Good luck!
npc.gnomus.multi_14: AMAZING! Not only did you salve all our friends - you also rescued the animals! Here is your reward and bonus! ...
npc.gnomus.multi_15: The other are already telling stories about you. Please return to me later if you want to help out some more!
npc.gnomus.multi_16: I am constantly waiting for ordnance to arrive. A lot of gnomes intend to travel out here to help us but the main access path to our base is not safe anymore. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_17: Tragically we lost several gnomes after an outbreak of what I can only describe as a force from below. We were completely surprised by their onslaught and retreated to this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_18: All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_19: Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_2: Take one from the stack here next to me and map as many structures as possible. However, we need at least three locations to make any sense of this ancient layout at all. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_21: I am constantly waiting for ordnance to arrive. A lot of gnomes intend to travel out here to help us but the main access path to our base is not safe anymore. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_22: Tragically we lost several gnomes after an outbreak of what I can only describe as a force from below. We were completely surprised by their onslaught and retreated to this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_23: All our reinforcements arrive at the crystal teleporter to the east of the cave system. We need someone to navigate the new arrivals through the hazards of the dangerous caves. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_24: Hideous creatures and hot lava makes travelling extremely dangerous. And on top of that there is also the constant danger from falling rocks in the area. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_26: How fortunate! There are some trignometres lying around next to that device behind me. Take one and hold it next to high temperature heat sources. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_27: If you gathered enough data, you will actually smell it from the device. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_28: Return to me with the results afterwards. Best of luck, we count on you!
npc.gnomus.multi_29: Excellent, you returned with more data! Let me see... hmm. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_3: If you manage to map one of each structure around these parts - I assume there must be at least two times as many around here - I will hand you a bonus!
npc.gnomus.multi_30: Well, we need more data on this but first I will have to show this to our grand horticulturist. Thank you for getting this for us!
npc.gnomus.multi_31: The heat down here is not the only problem we have but one of our greatest concerns. Not only is it almost unbearable for us, it also seems to be rising. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_32: We need to find out if this is true and what that means for this place - and for us gnomes. You can help us do this by grabbing one of our trignometres and collecting as much as data from the heat in this area as possible. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_33: We'd need at least 5 measurements. Are you willing to do this?

npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: If you're willing to help us, we could need an escort for arriving {ordnance}, help with {charting} the cave system and someone needs to get some heat {measurements} fast.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: I'm the main gnomish contact for this base. I coordinate our efforts with those of the dwarves to ensure everything is running smoothly.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_4:
You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found {suspicious devices} carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ... \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_5:
Our surveys of the area showed us some spikes in heat and seismic activity at very specific places. ... \z
	We conclude this is no coincidence and the enemy is using devices to pump up the lava to flood the area. We have seen it before and had to retreat each time. ... \z
	This time though we might have a counter prepared - given me manage to pierce their defences.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_6:
Gnomish supplies and ingenuity have helped to establish and fortify this outpost. ... \z
	Our knowledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gnomes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.

npc.gnomux.say_3: I came here as a crystal farmer and know the Spike all the way back to when it was a little baby crystal. I admit I feel a little fatherly pride in how big and healthy it has become.

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10a: Superb work. However, there is something else I want you to do. It is said that there is a quara general named 'Thul' who is responsible for the attacks on Liberty Bay. Find and kill the general and bring peace back to Liberty Bay! ...

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_2: Nicely done! Now I shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an ancient and evil tarantula who preys on humans. She is called 'Hide'. Track her down and kill her! Good luck, old chap.

npc.grizzly_adams.say_97: Have you heard about {Tiquanda's Revenge}? It is said that the jungle itself is alive and takes revenge for all the bad things people have done to it. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.say_98: I myself believe that there is some truth in this clap-trap. Something 'real' which must have a hideout somewhere. Go find it and take revenge yourself! Ask me about the {special} task when you're done.

npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ancient_sca: They can be found in tombs beneath the desert around Ankrahmun. Hunt 250 ancient scarabs of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_apes: You'll find the apes deeper in the jungle. Hunt 300 merlkins, kongras or sibangs to complete this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_badgers: You'll find them in the surrounding of Svargrond. Hunt 300 badgers and you'll get a reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_behemoths: Behemoths must be kept away from the settlements at all costs. You'll find them east of here in the taboo-area or under Cyclopolis in Edron. Go there and hunt a few of them - shall we say... 700? Are you up for that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_bonebeasts: In this task you must defeat 300 bonebeasts. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_brimstone_b: You can find them on the Zaoan landmass. Kill 500 brimstone bugs to complete this task. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crocodiles: They are a nuisance! You'll find them here in the jungle near the river. Hunt 300 crocodiles and you'll get a nice reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crystal_spi: In this task you must defeat 300 crystal spiders. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_destroyers: You can find those dark creatures on several places all over Tibia. For this task I want you to kill 650 destroyers. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_drakens: Go to the Zaoan landmass and reduce their number! Kill 900 drakens, I'll accept: draken abomination, draken elite, draken spellweaver and draken warmaster. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gargoyles: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 gargoyles of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ghastly_dra: Ghastly dragons are devastating creatures which can be found in many dangerous places all over Tibia. Kill 500 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_giant_spide: Never liked spiders. Simply too many legs. And I always find them in my bath! Those nasty creepy-crawlies are a threat to the hygiene of every living being in Tibia. Hunt 500 of them. Okay?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gnarlhounds: This particular species is found in Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 gnarlhounds of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellhounds: These harbingers of darkness can be found in many deep dungeons all over Tibia. Kill 250 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellspawns: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development - hellspawns. If they spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers. Hunt 600 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_high_class_: I want you to decrease the number of high class lizards on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 800 of them. I accept lizard chosens, lizard dragon priests, lizard high guards, lizard legionnaires and lizard zaoguns. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hydras: The hydras are located in the eastern jungle of Tiquanda and there are several mountain caves that are inhabited by them. Your task is to hunt a mere 650 hydras. Are you willing to do that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ice_golems: The ice golems on the glacier of Hrodmir are becoming a threat to the civilians in Svargrond. Travel to the Ice Islands and hunt 300 ice golems. Do you accept this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_killer_caim: Killer caiman populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 250 of them for this task. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_lancer_beet: Lancer beetle populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 300 of this crawlers for this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mammoths: This particular species is found in Svargrond. Impressive beasts, but you wouldn't want one in your backyard. Hunt 300 mammoths of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_medusae: They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta and they are nasty! I think a mere 500 medusae should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_bat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous mutated bats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_rat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous Mutated rats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia.. <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 mutated rats of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_tig: In this task you must defeat 300 mutated tigers. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_nightmares: Nightmares and nightmare scions can be found all over Tibia. For this task kill 400 of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_quara_scout: The {scouts} can be found on Malada, one of the Shattered Isles. Your task is to kill 400 quara scouts. I accept quara constrictor scouts, quara hydromancer scouts, quara mantassin scouts, quara pincher scouts and quara predator scouts, are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_sea_serpent: The sea serpent threat increases! Captain Haba knows where to find them. ...
Go to Svargrond and talk to him. 900 sea serpents, including the young ones, should be enough to reduce the threat. Got it?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_serpent_spa: Very dangerous, nasty and slimy creatures. They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta. I think a mere 800 serpent spawns should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stampors: Stampors can be found in a dungeon on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 600 of them. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stone_golem: They can be found all over Tibia. You'll find them in mountain caves or rocky dungeons. Hunt 200 stone golems of them and come back to me. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_tarantulas: There is a veritable plague of tarantulas living in the caves north of the river to the east. Can you squish 300 tarantulas for the Hunting Elite. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_terramites: This particular species can be found beneath Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 terramites of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_thornback_t: You'll find them on the Laguna Islands. Hunt 300 thornback tortoises of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_undead_drag: You are a thrill seeker? Undead dragons belong to one of the most powerful races that can be found in Tibia. Kill 400 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_underwater_: As you wish. Seek out a quara settlement and hunt 600 underwater quara, it doesn't matter which type you hunt. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wailing_wid: Wailing widow populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 400 of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_werewolves: Those nasty creatures can be found on the island of Vengoth. Hunt 300 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wyverns: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 wyverns. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_1: Nice work, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_2: Jolly good job you did there, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.

npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_4: That took some time, huh? Good hunting though. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.

npc.grof_the_guard.say_1: I think it'll rain soon and I left some laundry out for drying.
npc.grof_the_guard.say_2: Yes I'm pretty sure they have failed to send the laundry police to take care of it, you fool.
npc.grof_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.grombur.greet_msg_1: STOP RIGHT THERE!..... Oh, just a human. What's up big guy?
npc.grombur.say_1: Oh well, I liked Nokmir. He used to be a good dwarf until that day on which he stole the ring from {Rerun}.
npc.grombur.say_2: Yeah, he's the lucky guy in this whole story. I heard rumours that emperor Rehal had plans to promote Nokmir, but after this whole thievery story, he might pick Rerun instead.
npc.grombur.say_3: Got any dwarven brown ale?? I DON'T THINK SO....and Bolfana, the tavern keeper, won't sell you anything. I'm sure about that...she doesn't like humans... I tell you what, if you get me a cask of dwarven brown ale, I allow you to enter the mine. Alright?
npc.grombur.say_4: HOW?....WHERE?....AHHHH, I don't mind....SLUUUUUURP....tastes a little flat but I had worse. Thank you. Just don't tell anyone that I let you in.
npc.grombur.say_5: Haha, fine! Don't waste time and get me the ale. See you.
npc.guard_saros.farewell_msg_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_1: Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_2: Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.say_1: I would never have guessed that.
npc.guard_saros.say_11: I am a little sad, that you seem to have forgotten me, handsome. I am Aruda.
npc.guard_saros.say_13: Oh, I like it, how you say my name.
npc.guard_saros.say_14: Please don't be so rude to look for the time if you are talking to me.
npc.guard_saros.say_15: I am deeply sorry, I can't help you.
npc.guard_saros.say_16: UH! What a terrifying topic. Please let us speak about something more pleasant, I am a weak and small woman after all.
npc.guard_saros.say_17: What gives you the impression, I am the kind of women, you find in sewers?
npc.guard_saros.say_18: You should ask about that in one of the temples.
npc.guard_saros.say_19: The king, that lives in this fascinating castle? I think he does look kind of cute in his luxurious robes, doesn't he?
npc.guard_saros.say_2: Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?
npc.guard_saros.say_20: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! Did you ask him for a date?
npc.guard_saros.say_21: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! On the other hand, compared to you he looks quite puny.
npc.guard_saros.say_22: He is a little simple minded but always nice and well dressed.
npc.guard_saros.say_23: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
npc.guard_saros.say_24: I don't understand this lonely monks. I love company too much to become one. Hehehe!
npc.guard_saros.say_25: Oh, isn't he funny? I could listen to him the whole day.
npc.guard_saros.say_26: As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
npc.guard_saros.say_27: I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
npc.guard_saros.say_28: Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
npc.guard_saros.say_29: I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
npc.guard_saros.say_3: Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_30: I believe that love is stronger than magic, don't you agree?
npc.guard_saros.say_31: Oh, sorry, I have to hurry, bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_32: I would like to visit the beach more often, but I guess it's too dangerous.
npc.guard_saros.say_33: I love this castle! It's so beautiful.
npc.guard_saros.say_34: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
npc.guard_saros.say_35: I personally think it's inappropriate for a woman to become a warrior, what do you think about that?
npc.guard_saros.say_36: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
npc.guard_saros.say_37: I like brave fighters like him.
npc.guard_saros.say_39: I like dogs, the little ones at least. Do you like dogs, too?
npc.guard_saros.say_4: Take some time to talk to me!
npc.guard_saros.say_40: Oh, I am just a girl and know nothing about magic swords and such things.
npc.guard_saros.say_41: I ... don't know someone named like that.
npc.guard_saros.say_42: Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
npc.guard_saros.say_5: Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
npc.guard_saros.say_6: I remember that grapes were his favourites. He was almost addicted to them.
npc.guard_saros.say_7: Thank you very much. How kind of you to care about me. I am fine, thank you.
npc.guard_saros.say_8: This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city {Issavi}.
npc.guard_saros.say_9: Issavi is the capital of {Kilmaresh}, also called the Golden City. This city has a motto: An open gate for those of peace. This means, anyone is welcome here as long as they respect our laws, be it humans, elves, minotaurs or even a medusa.
npc.guard_saros.voice_1: Praised be Suon, the Benevolent King!
npc.guard_saros.walkaway_msg_1: I hope to see you soon.

npc.gurbasch.farewell_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.gurbasch.greet_msg_1: Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Farmine} or {Gnomprona}?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_1: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_10: Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_3:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_4: Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_7: Do you want to go to Kazordoon to try the beer there? |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.voice_1: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.habdel.greet_msg_1: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! See the fine {weapons} I sell.
npc.habdel.multi_1: Listen, um... I know that Ishina has been wanting a comb for a long time... not just any comb, but a mermaid's comb. She said it prevents split ends... or something. ...
npc.habdel.multi_2: Do you think you could get one for me so I can give it to her? I really would appreciate it.
npc.habdel.say_1: My scimitar? Yes, that is a true masterpiece. Of course I could make one for you, but I have a small request. Would you fulfil a task for me?
npc.habdel.say_2: Have you brought a mermaid's comb for Ishina?
npc.habdel.say_3: Brilliant! I will wait for you to return with a mermaid's comb then.
npc.habdel.say_5: Yeah! That's it! I can't wait to give it to her! Oh - but first, I'll fulfil my promise: Here is your scimitar! Thanks again!
npc.habdel.stdmod_1: I sell the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_1: Oh! Hello! Hello! Did not notice!
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_2: Be greeted, friend of the ape people. If you want to {trade}, just ask for my offers. If you are injured, ask for healing.
npc.hairycles.multi_1: So listen, please. Plague was not ordinary plague. That's why Hairycles could not heal at first. It is new curse of evil lizard people ...
npc.hairycles.multi_10: Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_11: Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_12: Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_13: You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_14: Finally my people are safe! You have done incredible good for ape people and one day even me brethren will recognise that. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_15: I wish I could speak for all when me call you true friend but my people need time to get accustomed to change. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_16: Let us hope one day whole Banuta will greet you as a friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.multi_17: You have proven yourself a friend, me will grant you permission to enter the deepest catacombs under Banuta which we have sealed in the past. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_18: Me still can sense the evil presence there. We did not dare to go deeper and fight creatures of evil there. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_19: You may go there, fight the evil and find the monument of the serpent god and destroy it with hammer me give to you. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_2: I think curse on little one was only a try. We have to be prepared for big strike ...
npc.hairycles.multi_20: Only then my people will be safe. Please tell Hairycles, will you go there?
npc.hairycles.multi_21: Now that the false cult was stopped, we need to strengthen the spirit of my people. We need a symbol of our faith that ape people can see and touch. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_22: Since you have proven a friend of the ape people I will grant you permission to enter the forbidden land. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_23: To enter the forbidden land in the north-east of the jungle, look for a cave in the mountains east of it. There you will find the blind prophet. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_24: Tell him Hairycles you sent and he will grant you entrance. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_25: Forbidden land is home of Bong. Holy giant ape big as mountain. Don't annoy him in any way but look for a hair of holy ape. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_26: You might find at places he has been, should be easy to see them since Bong is big. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_27: Return a hair of the holy ape to me. Will you do this for Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.multi_28: Mighty life charm is protecting us now! But my people are still in danger. Danger from within. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_29: Some of my people try to mimic lizards to become strong. Like lizards did before, this cult drinks strange fluid that lizards left when fled. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_3: Me need papers of lizard magician! For sure you find it in his hut in their dwelling. It's south east of jungle. Go look there please! Are you willing to go?
npc.hairycles.multi_30: Under the city still the underground temple of lizards is. There you find casks with red fluid. Take crowbar and destroy three of them to stop this madness. Are you willing to do that?
npc.hairycles.multi_31: Last ingredient for charm of life is thing to lure magic. Only thing me know like that is mushroom called witches' cap. Me was told it be found in isle called Fibula, where humans live. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_32: Hidden under Fibula is a secret dungeon. There you will find witches' cap. Are you willing to go there for good ape people?
npc.hairycles.multi_33: So much there is to do for Hairycles to prepare charm that will protect all ape people. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_34: You can help more. To create charm of life me need mighty token of life! Best is egg of a regenerating beast as a hydra is. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_35: Bring me egg of hydra please. You may find it in lair of Hydra at little lake south east of our lovely city Banuta! You think you can do?
npc.hairycles.multi_36: Ah yes that scroll. Sadly me not could read it yet. But the holy banana me insight gave! In dreams Hairycles saw where to find solution. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_37: Me saw a stone with lizard signs and other signs at once. If you read signs and tell Hairycles, me will know how to read signs. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_38: You go east to big desert. In desert there city. East of city under sand hidden tomb is. You will have to dig until you find it, so take shovel. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_39: Go down in tomb until come to big level and then go down another. There you find a stone with signs between two huge red stones. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_4: So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.multi_40: Read it and return to me. Are you up to that challenge?
npc.hairycles.multi_41: Whisper moss strong is, but me need liquid that humans have to make it work ...
npc.hairycles.multi_42: Our raiders brought it from human settlement, it's called cough syrup. Go ask healer there for it.
npc.hairycles.multi_5: Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_6: Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_7: Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_8: You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_9: So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.say_1: These are dire times for our people. Problems plenty are in this times. But me people not grant trust easy. Are you willing to prove you friend of ape people?
npc.hairycles.say_10: You brought Hairycles witches' cap from Fibula?
npc.hairycles.say_11: You do please Hairycles again, friend. Me hope madness will not spread further now. Perhaps you are ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_12: Please destroy three casks in the complex beneath Banuta, so my people will come to senses again.
npc.hairycles.say_13: You brought hair of holy ape?
npc.hairycles.say_14: Get a hair of holy ape from forbidden land in east. Speak with blind prophet in cave.
npc.hairycles.say_15: Me know its much me asked for but go into the deepest catacombs under Banuta and destroy the monument of the serpent god.
npc.hairycles.say_16: No more missions await you right now, friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.say_17: Oh you bring cookie for old Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_18: Me truly proud of you, friend. You learn many about plants, charms and ape people. Me want grant you shamanic power now. You ready?
npc.hairycles.say_19: You already are shaman and doctor. Me proud of you.
npc.hairycles.say_2: Oh, you brought me whisper moss? Good hairless ape you are! Can me take it?
npc.hairycles.say_20: You not have finished journey for wisdom yet, young human.
npc.hairycles.say_21: You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_22: You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_23: To become friend of ape people a long and difficult way is. We do not trust easy but help is needed. Will you listen to story of Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_24: Hairycles sad is now. But perhaps you will change mind one day.
npc.hairycles.say_26: Stupid, you no have the moss me need. Go get it. It's somewhere in dworc lair. If you lost it, they might restocked it meanwhile. If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_27: Ah yes! That's it. Thank you for bringing mighty whisper moss to Hairycles. It will help but still much is to be done. Just ask for other mission if you ready.
npc.hairycles.say_28: Strange being you are! Our people need help!
npc.hairycles.say_29: No no, not right syrup you have. Go get other, get right health syrup.
npc.hairycles.say_3: Please hurry. Bring me whisper moss from dworc lair. Make sure it is from dworc lair! Take it yourself only! If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_30: You so good! Brought syrup to me! Thank you, will prepare cure now. Just ask for {mission} if you want help again.
npc.hairycles.say_32: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_33: Good thing that is! Report about your mission when have scroll.
npc.hairycles.say_34: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_35: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_36: No! That not scroll me looking for. Silly hairless ape you are. Go to village of lizards and get it there on your own!
npc.hairycles.say_37: You brought scroll with lizard text? Good! I will see what text tells me! Come back when ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_38: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_39: Good thing that is! Report about mission when you have read those signs.
npc.hairycles.say_4: You brought me that cough syrup from human healer me asked for?
npc.hairycles.say_40: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_41: Oh, so clear is all now! Easy it will be to read the signs now! Soon we will know what to do! Thank you again! Ask for mission if you feel ready.
npc.hairycles.say_42: Me need to see it in your mind, other there is no way to proceed.
npc.hairycles.say_43: You brave hairless ape! Get me hydra egg. If you lose egg, you probably have to fight many, many hydras to get another.
npc.hairycles.say_44: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_45: You not have egg of hydra. Please get one!
npc.hairycles.say_46: Ah, the egg! Mighty warrior you be! Thank you. Hairycles will put it at safe place immediately.
npc.hairycles.say_47: Please hurry. Hairycles not knows when evil lizards strike again.
npc.hairycles.say_48: Long journey it will take, good luck to you.
npc.hairycles.say_49: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_5: Little ape should be healthy soon. Me so happy is. Thank you again! But me suspect we in more trouble than we thought. Will you help us again?
npc.hairycles.say_50: Not right mushroom you have. Find me a witches' cap on Fibula!
npc.hairycles.say_51: Incredible, you brought a witches' cap! Now me can prepare mighty charm of life. Yet still other {missions} will await you, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_52: Please try to find me a witches' cap on Fibula.
npc.hairycles.say_53: Hairycles sure you will make it. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_55: Hairycles proud of you. Go and find holy hair. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_57: You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_58: Incredible! You got a hair of holy Bong! This will raise the spirit of my people. You are truly a friend. But one last mission awaits you.
npc.hairycles.say_59: You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_6: You got scroll from lizard village in south east?
npc.hairycles.say_60: Hairycles sure you will make it. Just use hammer on all that looks like snake or lizard. Tell Hairycles if you succeed with mission.
npc.hairycles.say_62: Friend of the ape people! Take my gift and become me apprentice! Here is shaman clothing for you!
npc.hairycles.say_64: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.hairycles.say_65: Thank you, you are ... YOU SON OF LIZARD!
npc.hairycles.say_7: Ah yes, you read the signs in tomb? Good! May me look into your mind to see what you saw?
npc.hairycles.say_8: You still don't know signs on stone, go and look for it in tomb east in desert.
npc.hairycles.say_9: You bring Hairycles egg of hydra?
npc.hairycles.stdmod_1: Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me know many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_2: We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_3: Things not good now. Need helper to do {mission} for me people.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_4: We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_5: Kongra verry strong. Kongra verry angry verry fast. Take care when kongra comes. Better climb on highest tree.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_6: Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang know {jungle} well.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_7: Merlkin we are. Merlkin verry wise, merlkin learn many things quick. Teach other apes things a lot. Making {heal} and making {magic}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_8: We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_9: Jungle is dangerous. Jungle also provides us food. Take care when in jungle and safe you be.
npc.hal.say_1: Hicks! I... I... <he is obviously drunk and his report more than confusing>.
npc.hal.say_2: You can {pass} either to the {Arena Quarter} or {Alchemist Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.halvar.greet_msg_1: Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
npc.halvar.say_1: So you agree with the {rules} and want to participate in the {challenge}? The {fee} for one try in {{}} is {} gold pieces. Do you really want to participate and pay the {fee}?
npc.halvar.say_13: You already paid the fee, go and fight!
npc.halvar.say_15: You've already completed the arena in all {difficulty levels}.
npc.halvar.say_16: As you wish! You can pass the door now and enter the teleporter to the pits.
npc.halvar.say_17: You do not have enough money.
npc.halvar.say_18: Come back when you are ready then.
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.hamish.greet_msg_1: Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
npc.hamish.say_1: Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.say_2: Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.say_3: Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
npc.hamish.say_4: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
npc.hamish.say_5: I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end!
npc.hamish.say_6: Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>
npc.hamish.say_7: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.hamish.sendtrade_msg_1: Take your pick! Or maybe you want to look only at {potions}, {wands} or {runes}?
npc.hamish.stdmod_10: Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.stdmod_2: Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_3: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and buy a new one here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_4: Ran out of mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!
npc.hamish.stdmod_5: Low on magic and need a little extra? Get yourself a rune!
npc.hamish.stdmod_6: Pack of monsters give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!
npc.hamish.stdmod_7: Health potions to refill your health in combat!
npc.hamish.stdmod_8: Taking back empty potion flasks! Get your deposit back here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_9: Careful with that! That's a highly reactive potion you have there!

npc.hanna.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Have a look at my wonderful {offers} in gems and jewellery.
npc.hanna.say_1: Pretty, isn't it? My friend Amber taught me how to make it, but I could help you with one if you like. What do you say?
npc.hanna.say_2: Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.hanna.say_4: Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue. That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!
npc.hanna.say_5: Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.hanna.say_6: Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.hanna.say_7: Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.hanna.say_8: Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.

npc.henricus.multi_1: Even though they claim differently, this city is in the firm grip of Zathroth and his evil minions. Their whole twisted religion is a mockery of the teachings of our gods ...
npc.henricus.multi_10: Concerned, the inquisition watches the attempts of these guilds to become more and more independent and to make own decisions. ...
npc.henricus.multi_11: Unfortunately, the sorcerer guild has become dangerously influential and so the hands of our priests are tied due to political matters ...
npc.henricus.multi_12: The druids lately claim that they are serving Crunor's will and not Uman's. Such heresy could only become possible with the independence of Carlin from the Thaian kingdom. ...
npc.henricus.multi_13: The spiritual centre of the druids switched to Carlin where they have much influence and cannot be supervised by the inquisition.
npc.henricus.multi_14: In the past, the order of Banor was the only order of knighthood in existence. In the course of time, the order concentrated more and more on spiritual matters rather than on worldly ones. ...
npc.henricus.multi_15: Nowadays, the order of Banor sanctions new orders and offers spiritual guidance to the fighters of good.
npc.henricus.multi_16: The Thaian kings are crowned by a representative of the churches. This means they reign in the name of the gods of good and are part of the godly plan for humanity. ...
npc.henricus.multi_17: As nominal head of the church of Banor, the kings aren't only worldly but also spiritual authorities. ...
npc.henricus.multi_18: The kings fund the inquisition and sometimes provide manpower in matters of utmost importance. The inquisition, in return, protects the realm from heretics and individuals that aim to undermine the holy reign of the kings.
npc.henricus.multi_19: The dark powers are always present. If a human shows only the slightest weakness, they try to corrupt him and to lure him into their service. ...
npc.henricus.multi_2: As soon as we have gathered the strength, we should crush this city once and for all.
npc.henricus.multi_20: We must be constantly aware of evil that comes in many disguises.
npc.henricus.multi_21: Incredible! You're a true defender of faith! I grant you the title of a High Inquisitor for your noble deeds. From now on you can obtain the blessing of the inquisition which makes the pilgrimage of ashes obsolete ...
npc.henricus.multi_22: The blessing of the inquisition will bestow upon you all available blessings for the price of 110000 gold. Also, don't forget to ask me about your {outfit} to receive the final addon as demon hunter.
npc.henricus.multi_23: Indeed, this is exactly what my other sources told me. Of course I knew the outcome of this investigation in advance. This was just a test. ...
npc.henricus.multi_24: Well, now that you've proven yourself as useful, you can ask me for another mission. Let's see if you can handle some field duty, too.
npc.henricus.multi_25: So the beast is finally dead! Thank the gods. At least some things work out in our favour ...
npc.henricus.multi_26: Our other operatives were not that lucky, though. But you will learn more about that in your next {mission}.
npc.henricus.multi_27: We've got information about something very dangerous going on on the isle of Edron. The demons are preparing something there ...
npc.henricus.multi_28: Something that is a threat to all of us. Our investigators were able to acquire vital information before some of them were slain by a demon named Ungreez. ...
npc.henricus.multi_29: It'll be your task to take revenge and to kill that demon. You'll find him in the depths of Edron. Good luck.
npc.henricus.multi_3: Edron illustrates perfectly why the inquisition is needed and why we need more funds and manpower. ...
npc.henricus.multi_30: You're indeed a dedicated protector of the true believers. Don't stop now. Kill as many of these creatures as you can. ...
npc.henricus.multi_31: I also have a reward for your great efforts. Talk to me about your {demon hunter outfit} anytime from now on. Afterwards, let's talk about the next mission that's awaiting you.
npc.henricus.multi_32: You've handled heretics, witches, vampires and ghosts. Now be prepared to face the most evil creatures we are fighting - demons. Your new task is extremely simple, though far from easy. ...
npc.henricus.multi_33: Go and slay demonic creatures wherever you find them. Bring me 20 of their essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
npc.henricus.multi_34: We've got a report about an abandoned and haunted house in Liberty Bay. I want you to examine this house. It's the only ruin in Liberty Bay so you should have no trouble finding it. ...
npc.henricus.multi_35: There's an evil being somewhere. I assume that it will be easier to find the right spot at night. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
npc.henricus.multi_36: I think it's time to truly test your abilities. One of our allies has requested assistance. I think you are just the right person to help him ...
npc.henricus.multi_37: Storkus is an old and grumpy dwarf who works as a vampire hunter since many, many decades. He's quite successful but even hehas his limits. ...
npc.henricus.multi_38: So occasionally, we send him help. In return he trains and tests our recruits. It's an advantageous agreement for both sides ...
npc.henricus.multi_39: You'll find him in his cave at the mountain outside of Kazordoon. He'll tell you about your next mission.
npc.henricus.multi_4: Our agents were on their way to investigate certain occurrences there when some faithless knights fled to some unholy ruins. ...
npc.henricus.multi_40: Listen, we have information about a heretic coven that hides in a mountain called the Big Old One. The witches reach this cursed place on flying brooms and think they are safe there. ...
npc.henricus.multi_41: I've arranged a flying carpet that will bring you to their hideout. Travel to Femor Hills and tell the carpet pilot the codeword 'eclipse' ...
npc.henricus.multi_42: He'll bring you to your destination. At their meeting place, you'll find a cauldron in which they cook some forbidden brew ...
npc.henricus.multi_43: Use this vial of holy water to destroy the brew. Also steal their grimoire and bring it to me.
npc.henricus.multi_44: Let's see if you are worthy. Take an inquisitor's field guide from the box in the back room. ...
npc.henricus.multi_45: Follow the instructions in the guide to talk to the Thaian guards that protect the walls and gates of the city and test their loyalty. Then report to me about your {mission}.
npc.henricus.multi_5: We were unable to wipe them out and the local order of knighthood was of little help. ...
npc.henricus.multi_6: It's almost sure that something dangerous is going on there, so we have to continue our efforts.
npc.henricus.multi_7: Fafnar is mostly worshipped by the peasants and farmers in rural areas. ...
npc.henricus.multi_8: The inquisition has a close eye on these activities. Simply people tend to mix local superstitions with the teachings of the gods. This again may lead to heretical subcults.
npc.henricus.multi_9: The church of Uman oversees the education of the masses as well as the doings of the sorcerer and druid guilds. It decides which lines of research are in accordance with the will of Uman and which are not. ...

npc.henricus.stdmod_1: It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eyes open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: The church of Crunor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the enormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
