npc.zlak.say_5: I need you to enter ze zity and zlay at leazt zix noblez. Ze otherz will feel zreatened and call guardz to zemzelvez, and ze dragon kingz will accuze each ozer to be rezponzible for zlaying zeir pet noblez. ...
npc.zlak.say_6: Zat should enable uz to give you at leazt a chanze to attack ze palaze.
npc.zlak.say_7: Word of your deedz iz already zpreading like a wildfire. Zalamon'z plan to unleash zome murderouz beaztz in ze zity workz almozt too well. You are already becoming zome kind of legend with which motherz frighten zeir unruly hatchlingz. ...
npc.zlak.say_8: Your next {mizzion} will be a ztrike into ze heart of ze empire.
npc.zlak.say_9: Your eagernezz for killing and bloodshed iz frightening, but your next mizzion will zuit your tazte. Wiz ze zity in chaoz and defenzez diverted, ze ztage iz zet for our final ztrike. ...
npc.znozel.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.znozel.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.zoltan.greet_msg_1: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|, student of the arcane arts. I teach the fiercest {spells} available.
npc.zoltan.say_1: [EN] Bah, I know. I received some sort of 'nomination' from our outpost in Port Hope. ...
npc.zoltan.say_10: Usually it takes a little more than that for an award though. However, I honour Myra's word. ...
npc.zoltan.say_11: I hereby grant you the right to wear a special sign of honour, acknowledged by the academy of Edron. Since you are a woman, I guess you don't want manly stuff. There you go.
npc.zoltan.say_2: [EN] Usually it takes a little more than that for an award though. However, I honour Myra's word. ...
npc.zoltan.say_3: [EN] I hereby grant you the right to wear a special sign of honour, acknowledged by the academy of Edron. Since you are a woman, I guess you don't want manly stuff. There you go.
npc.zoltan.say_4: I bow to you, player, and hereby grant you the right to wear Ferumbras' hat as accessory. Congratulations!
npc.zoltan.say_5: Sorry you don't have the Ferumbras' hat.
npc.zoltan.say_6: This task is only available for male players who don't already have the addon.
npc.zoltan.say_7: Stop bothering me. I am a far too busy man to be constantly giving out awards.
npc.zoltan.say_8: What the hell are you talking about?
npc.zoltan.say_9: Bah, I know. I received some sort of 'nomination' from our outpost in Port Hope. ...
npc.zora.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.zora.say_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.zora.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.zora.stdmod_1: I sell equipment for your adventure! Just ask me for a {trade} to see my wares.
npc.ztiss.multi_1: Excellent! Now you may leave ziz area zrough ze teleporter to ze norz. It will bring you to a hidden boat. Ziz boat will take you to ze tournament izle. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_2: Zere you'll learn anyzing you need to know about ze great tournament.
npc.ztiss.multi_3: You are zmart for a zoftzkin, but before you begin to feel too zmart, you should know zat we will zeal our deal wiz you drinking a ztrong poizon zat will inevitably kill you if you want to trick me and not attend ze tournament. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_4: Zo are you ready to drink ziz poizon here?
npc.ztiss.multi_5: Zere iz a great tournament of ztrengz each decade. It determinez ze granted privilegez for zertain individualz of power for ze comming decade. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_6: My mazter wantz to zurprize hiz opponentz by an unexpected move. He will uze warriorz from ze outzide, zomeone zat no one can azzezz. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_7: One of ziz warriorz could be you. Or you could ztay here and rot in ze dungeon. Are you interezted in ziz deal?
npc.ztiss.multi_8: Ziz iz not for you to azk. I work for zomeone of immenze power. He haz an {offer} for you.
npc.ztiss.say_1: You are ztill a captive and your life is forfeit. Zere might be a way for you to ezcape if you agree to {work} for my mazter.
npc.zumtah.greet_msg_1: Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.multi_1: Oh, excuse me of course, you... wanted to go. Like all... the others. I am sorry, so sorry. You... you can leave. Yes. You can go. You are free. I shall stay here and help every poor soul which ever gets thrown in here from this day onward. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_2: Yes, I will redeem myself. Maybe in another 278 years. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_3: If you want to go, just ask for an {exit} and I will transform you into a creature small enough to fit through that hole over there.
npc.zumtah.say_1: You are searching for the way out? Do you want to go home? Are you homesick, nostalgic, allergic? I am sorry. You will stay. Muhahahaha. Haha. Are you giving up then?
npc.zumtah.say_10: You are starting to get on my nerves. Is this the only topic you know?
npc.zumtah.say_11: But there is no escape, I said NO. You've already asked several times and my answer will stay the same. What is this? Are you trying to test me?
npc.zumtah.say_12: Muhahaha. Where? I can only see a dark cave with nothing than bones and a djinn in it. You mean that small hole there? Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_14: [EN] Muhahaha. Then I will give you a test. How many years do you think have I been here? {89}, {164} or {278}?
npc.zumtah.say_15: Correct human, and that is not nearly how high you would need to count to tell all the lost souls I've seen dying here. I AM PERPETUAL. Muahahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_2: A what? I don't even know what you're talking about, human. If you aren't just giving up - will you kindly change the topic please?
npc.zumtah.say_3: Haha, no! No. Why don't you just stop asking me that and start enjoying your stay here?
npc.zumtah.say_4: Oh, you mean - if I have ever been out of here in those 278 years? Well, I - I can't remember. No, I can't remember. Sorry.
npc.zumtah.say_5: No, I really can't remember. I enjoyed my stay here so much that I forgot how it looks outside of this hole. Outside. The air, the sky, the light. Oh well... well.
npc.zumtah.say_6: Oh yes, yes. I... I never really thought about how you creatures feel in here I guess. I... just watched all these beings die here. ...
npc.zumtah.say_7: Alright, as I said you are free now. There will not be an outside for the next three centuries, but you - go. ...
npc.zumtah.say_8: It's you, why did they throw you in here again? Anyway, I will just transform you once more. I also recovered your crate which will wait for you at the exit. There, feel free to go.
npc.zumtah.say_9: I've already told you that you can't get out. What's the problem? Do you even see an exit?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_1: I wait. I wait for someone like you to come here. I wait for them to grow disconsolate. I wait for them to despair. And I wait for them to die. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_2: I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_3: The land you are currently dwelling in, human. Don't you have any sense of your surroundings?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_4: I have seen many of them. I have seen many of them die. In here, with me. Perhaps you will be pleased to meet them. Not long and you will join their ranks. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_5: Pesky creatures. Many of them have been brought here, many of them died here. Humans, lizards, beasts, they all die the same. Down here, with me. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_6: What? What do you mean by that?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_7: Hmm, an old one. I don't care much about politics or power, as here, he has none. Here, only I have power. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_8: What are you talking about, such things do not matter down here. Down here alone, isolated and broken. Muhaha.
